domain_note: All pairs are framed as support/FAQ queries for a generic cloud storage and collaboration product, so the set reads as one coherent scenario rather than random trivia.

categories.paraphrase: query_b means the same thing as query_a, worded differently. A cache hit here is correct.
categories.near_miss: query_b shares vocabulary/topic with query_a but asks something meaningfully different. A cache hit here would be a wrong answer served with high confidence, this is the hard negative bucket the threshold has to catch.
categories.unrelated: query_b is a different feature area entirely, low lexical overlap. Easy negative, a sanity check that the pipeline isn't badly broken.
